data.one_liner: A Flutter-first 3D engine for rendering glTF models with physics and a real‑time game loop.
data.what_it_does: Glint renders glTF/GLB models as Flutter widgets, supporting PBR lighting, skeletal animation, and deterministic physics. It also provides a ticker‑driven game loop and lets you pin regular Flutter widgets to 3D points.
use_when: building 3D games or interactive product showcases in Flutter
need real‑time physics, skeletal animation, or vehicle dynamics
want to overlay Flutter UI directly onto 3D scenes
avoid_when: requiring ultra‑high‑performance native 3D like Unity or Unreal
cannot enable Flutter GPU in the app
strengths: Deep integration with Flutter GPU for high performance
Full glTF 2.0 support with PBR, HDRI, and animation
Ability to embed any Flutter widget in 3D space
weaknesses: Limited platform support (Android, iOS, macOS only)
Early‑stage API; breaking changes expected before 1.0
Requires manual manifest changes to enable Flutter GPU
data.setup_notes: Add Flutter GPU flags to iOS/Info.plist, macOS/Info.plist, and AndroidManifest.xml as described in the README; no additional native code needed.
